description: Run URL Inspection on a URL — opens the inspect tool, fills the URL, polls up to 30s for the result panel, returns structured JSON (pageIndexed, verdict, indexingState, coverage, canonicalUser, canonicalGoogle, lastCrawl, crawlStatus, crawlAllowed, fetchStatus, robotsAllowed, sitemap, referringPage, httpStatus, enhancements, summary, fullText).

url.description: Absolute URL to inspect (must belong to the active GSC property).
